name: Tender Board Activity Agent
description: An agent that monitors Tender Board activity in the shared MongoDB application log collection (applicationlogs). It fetches, classifies, and summarizes activity over a date range; detects error patterns and anomalies (duplicate-submit tender clusters, unusually slow requests); runs one LLM-based deep-analysis pass per report, screened for prompt injection and validated before being shown; and offers an interactive chat mode for free-form questions about the logs via a set of read-only tools.
target_audience: Tender Board product/engineering team; DevOps and support staff monitoring SafeAI-613 system health
tasks_capable_of_performing: Fetch, classify, and summarize Tender Board activity (create/register/edit/delete/view) over a date range
Detect and summarize error patterns across backend modules, de-duplicated by request
Detect duplicate-submit tender clusters and unusually slow requests
Run one LLM analysis pass per report for business-logic sanity, error-pattern, and anomaly narration
Answer free-form interactive questions about the logs via a chat interface with six read-only tools
examples_of_suitable_questions: How many tenders were created in the last 30 days?
How many errors happened in the tenderBoard module this week?
Show me the full trace for requestId <id>.
Were there any duplicate tender submissions today?
What is the p95 latency for the smart-search endpoint?
How many tenders were created per day, grouped by productType?
